snippet.title: Paris Transylvania | Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Paris Transylvania is a pachinko roguelike deckbuilder. 

Demo is out now! Featuring massive update with new art style, updated UI and characters, new locations, tons of new relics and cards, status effects, board editor, and lore.  Play and wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459560/Paris_Transylvania/
